turns.text: Hi, I am trying to book the specialist appointment I was referred for.
Okay I can look at that. Do you have the referral date?
Yes, it was issued on the ninth.
I see. And do you prefer mornings or afternoons for appointments?
Mornings are easier for me.
Do you require step-free access at the building?
No, stairs are fine for me.

Okay. We have an opening at our downtown location this Thursday at 9:00 a.m. However, if you're willing to travel to our midtown location, we have an opening tomorrow at 10:00 a.m. Would you travel to the midtown site if it were sooner?
Yes, I could manage that.
Great. Would you like a reminder message beforehand?
Yes, a message would help.
Okay, and are you currently taking any regular medication?
Just a vitamin supplement.
Okay, I've made a note of that. And is your current address still 1450 Elm Street?
Yes, nothing has moved.
Where did the referral originate?
I am not sure; I do not have the referral-source detail available.
Do you have a preferred practitioner at the practice?
No, whoever is available is fine.
Have you seen this specialist before?
No, this would be the first visit.
Alright. Let me just confirm your phone number. Is it still 555-555-340?
Yes, that one is right.
I will Send the booking through for coverage approval.
Okay, I will hold on while that happens.
I checked back after half an hour and the approval came back refused. I do not understand why.
I will Obtain the qualifying document from the provider type the policy requires.
